mapper.select: select con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, con.Con_Party_B_Id as conPartyBId, c1.C_Name as conPartyBName, c1.C_Abbreviation as conPartyBAbbName, c2.C_Name as vrCname, dp.D_Name as vrDname, cl.Cl_Code as clCode, cl.Cl_Title as clTitle, cl.Cl_Location as clLocation, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, pro.P_Name as pName, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, enis.Enis_Project_Name as enisName, enis.Enis_Code as enisCode, mn.* from Con_Visa_Record mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join Con_Contact_List cl on cl.Cl_Id = mn.Vr_Cl_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID = mn.Vr_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department left join SYS_Company c1 on con.Con_Party_B_Id = c1.C_Id left join Con_Enis enis on enis.Enis_Id=mn.Enis_Id left join Sys_Company c2 on c2.C_Id=mn.Vr_Cid left join Sys_Department dp on dp.D_Id=mn.Vr_Did where mn.Vr_Id = #{vrId}
